title: jmap-blob: umbrella re-export crate (replaces the 0.0.1 placeholder)
description:
Design: docs/design/blobext.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: B22. Crates: jmap-blob (new), workspace root. Size: S.

Per docs/design/DECISIONS.md decision 4 and docs/design/blobext.md §3 and §9 (crates.io): bring the claimed crates.io placeholder jmap-blob (0.0.1, 'RFC 9404') into the workspace as crate-jmap-blob/, an umbrella facade like the JMAP-amr2 jmap-mail umbrella: re-export jmap-blob-types always and jmap-blob-client / jmap-blob-server behind `client` / `server` features (keep the 0.0.1 module names if it published any; check its source first). Cargo description updated to blobext-03 with RFC 9404 legacy support. Root: workspace members, [workspace.dependencies], AGENTS.md crate map row (it is the first umbrella in the workspace; JMAP-amr2 and siblings follow its shape), RELEASING.md layer 5, publishes on the shared jmap-* version line. This bead also completes JMAP-m4nc's Done-when (m4nc is folded into JMAP-tna1). Acceptance: builds with no features, client, server and all features; a test parses the RFC 9404 §3.1.1 and blobext-03 §2.1.1 capability examples through the re-exports; public-api snapshot; README.
